title: Recorded Jev answer
description: One cassette: a POST /v1/systemone request the harness sent in live mode and every answer the model gave it during one recording run, in order, filed as fixtures/cassettes/<model>/<request_digest>.json and replayed by the cassette server in cassette mode (tools/eval/CASSETTES.md). request_digest is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the request's {model, state, questions}: keys sorted, no whitespace, values as JSON.stringify prints them. Since 2026-09-24 a cassette keeps one recording per GATE_PERSIST_SIM_MIN (persist_sim_min, other_recordings), because the Jev thresholds pre-registration records the tuning list at N = 0 and N = 1 into one store and the two recordings send many of the same requests; a replay at N is served the recording made at N. A cassette holds the state (fictional machine words), the questions and the answers; it never holds a key, a header or a scenario label.

model.description: The pinned model id the request asked for; the cassette directory is named after it.

backend_version.description: The @fdp/backend version whose state and question builders produced the request.

state.description: The decision state, as the backend built it.

persist_sim_min.description: The GATE_PERSIST_SIM_MIN of the recording run whose answers response and repeat_responses hold. Absent on a cassette recorded before recordings were told apart, which a replay serves at any value, except the pre-registered sweep's, which serves it at none.

response.description: What the model answered the first time the recording run sent this request.

repeat_responses.description: What the model answered each further time the same recording run sent the same request, in the order it was sent. The model does not answer a repeated request identically, so a replay serves the n-th answer to the n-th time the request arrives; absent when the run sent the request once.

other_recordings.description: The answers recording runs made at other GATE_PERSIST_SIM_MIN values gave the same request, one recording per value, each value different from persist_sim_min and from the others. A recording run replaces the recording at its own value and keeps the others.

recording.description: One recording run's answers to the request: at which GATE_PERSIST_SIM_MIN, when, by which @fdp/backend, and every answer in the order the run received them.

answers.description: The answers by question id, as the model returned them.
